comparison.objective: Extend an assistive-equipment handle and engage its detent.
comparison.physical_skill: Withdraw a pin, translate a telescoping member, and positively re-engage the pin.
comparison.success_condition: Selected extension is locked before release; the available body lacks numeric thresholds.
comparison.reason: Pin-indexed telescoping adjustment differs from preserving a screw setting during jam-nut tightening and then cycling it.
